Exact wording retained, but neither this named field nor Modeling and Simulation doctorate nor actual School of Modeling Simulation and Training explicitly names Operations Research, Operations Management, Management Science or Industrial Engineering. sources.note: Full substantive PhD degree and curriculum text read. Doctoral students must focus study/research in at least one specialization; thirteen listed common specializations explicitly include Operational Modeling, Simulation, and Optimization. This is stronger formal doctoral-field evidence than generic research-group methods; exact Operational wording retained, not renamed Operations Research.
